Entire script exercises Bitcoin-only nonce preimages and compact nBits/target difficulty1-to4 retarget at heights2015/2016 using data/mainnet_alt.json. PoCX replaces the SHA256 PoW algorithm and Bitcoin2016block retarget with storage-proof base-target adjustment, so these exact PoW vectors and expected fields are inapplicable. No generic mining/GBT/block-validation assertions occur in this script; mixed mining_basic.py remains required. Native consensus difficulty is covered by the separately completed unit package, while native proof/forging functional cases remain required.
To run this test make sure that 1.1.1.1 (a routable address) is assigned to one of the interfaces on this machine and rerun with --ihave1111
To run this test make sure that 1.1.1.1 and 2.2.2.2 (routable addresses) are assigned to the interfaces on this machine and rerun with --ihave1111and2222
